title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
script:
The Wikimedia Foundation is intervening in landmark artificial intelligence copyright lawsuits.
The operator behind Wikipedia is urging courts to protect large language models training on copyrighted material.
At the same time, the foundation argues chatbots must be barred from regurgitating that copyrighted work directly to users.
An overly rigid legal ruling could deprive Wikipedians of essential AI-based tools.
Would you protect training data while blocking chatbot outputs?
